classification.ENFORCED: an R120 message (any level) in P1 of the syntax, and none in P0 and P2 of that syntax

classification.INCONCLUSIVE: the UBL positive twin does not show R120 in P1; R120 appears in P0 or P2 (also recorded as VAL); wrong or no scenario; XSD failure, processing error or missing step
